# Price the lesson, not just the hour.

> Free music lesson pricing calculator for independent teachers. Include cancellations, preparation, travel, studio costs, and target pay to find a sustainable lesson price.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This calculator vs. My Music Staff](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/music-lesson-break-even/vs-mymusicstaff.html)
- [This calculator vs. picking a rate off the going local price](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/music-lesson-break-even/vs-picking-a-rate-off-the-going-local-price.html)
